notes.title: Summer Sale! Yay!
notes.content:
Hey there!

You can get TIDIMS for a discounted price (50%) during the Summer Sale!

In other news, I'm still working on the Exhibition update – there's been some stuff I had to focus on, but I wrapped up the new music for the patch and will be moving onto the other assets.

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2!
notes.content:
The version 1.1.2 is here! It features mostly visual changes, with some additional bugfixes (most importantly, getting rid off the progression blocker in the Elevator scene). The next patch, unless something very urgent comes up, will be the main part of the Exhibition (1.2.0) update. I'll be adding a new area to explore (the titular exhibition) as well as some more QoL changes – key binding remapping, among others.

Cheers!

notes.title: Spring Sale!
notes.content:
Hey!

You can get TIDIMS with a hefty 50% discount during the Spring Sale! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Winter Sale! + What's coming next
notes.content:
Hi there! 

You can grab TIDIMS with a 30% discount during the Steam Winter Sale!

Additionally, the next patch (titled The Exhibition) is coming in early 2024 – bugfixes as usual, some visual changes and tweaks, plus a new area to explore, separate from the game's story.

Cheers!

notes.title: Polish&Polish (1.1.0) – now live!
notes.content:
Hi! 

I'm happy to say that the Polish&Polish update is (finally) here! Took a few days longer than I anticipated, but is well worth the wait, methinks.

So, the changes:
[list]
[*] Added full Polish voice over
[*] Reworked and rebuilt lighting in all levels (more light sources, more dynamic appearance, higher fidelity)
[*] Added/reworked some areas and objects to the levels
[*] Memory optimizations
[*] Localized the "Loading..." string
[*] Added a prompt whenether the game is saved
[*] Fixed a bug causing highlighted Memory lines to display improperly
[*] Tweaked how the final sequence unfolds musically
[*] Added an option to invert the camera's Y-axis 
[*] Changed the way initial dialogue activates in several scenes
[*] Increased pauses between staged dialogue segments
[*] Fixed UVs of several objects
[*] Added missing colliders to several scenes
[*] Added graffiti to a few scenes
[*] Other, minor bugfixes
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: TIDIMS Soundtrack is now out for free!
notes.content:
Hi!

You can now download the music tracks from the game! Enjoy!

In other news, the Polish&Polish patch is almost done (in-game tweaks are largely ready, both Polish VO and a few English reworks are recorded, currently busy on mixing and mastering), so it'll be rolling out in a few days – maybe by the end of the week, if all goes well. As an example of QoL improvements coming in, here's an updated entry to the sewers, illuminated nicely by added in-game objects and, thus, less spatially confusing:

notes.title: TIDIMS is out!
notes.content:
Hello! 
I'm super-very-mega happy to announce that TIDIMS is out! In the upcoming days (probably within a week), it will also see the first major update – "Polish & Polish," containing some technical polish and, well, Polish voice-over. 
Much love,
Jakub
